definitions.name: N_H
definitions.source_text: let N_H = S_H + E_H + I_H + R_H

definitions.name: lambda_H
definitions.source_text: let lambda_H = (beta_BH * (I_B + I_R) + beta_AH * (I_A + I_r)) / N_H

transitions.name: emerge_S_B
transitions.source_text: emerge_S_B    : L_B --> S_B    @ (1 - phi_B) * tau_L * L_B

transitions.name: emerge_S_R
transitions.source_text: emerge_S_R    : L_B --> S_R    @ phi_B * tau_L * L_B

transitions.name: emerge_S_A
transitions.source_text: emerge_S_A    : L_A --> S_A    @ (1 - phi_A) * tau_L * L_A

transitions.name: emerge_S_r
transitions.source_text: emerge_S_r    : L_A --> S_r    @ phi_A * tau_L * L_A

scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.source_text:
baseline {
    label = "baseline  (co-endemic)"
    simulate { to = 280 'days }
    set = {
      # Human demographics
      Pi_H  = 0.45
      mu_H  = 0.000045
      tau   = 0.0001
      eps_H = 0.083
      gamma = 0.02
      omega = 0.005

      # Transmission
      beta_BH = 0.3
      beta_AH = 0.2
      beta_HB = 0.08
      beta_HA = 0.06

      # Larval (shared)
      mu_L  = 0.05
      tau_L = 0.1

      # An. funestus
      pi_B    = 500.0
      phi_B   = 0.3
      mu_B    = 0.05
      mu_R    = 0.05
      eps_B   = 0.067
      eps_R   = 0.067
      sigma_B = 0.33
      sigma_R = 0.5

      # An. arabiensis
      pi_A    = 500.0
      phi_A   = 0.3
      mu_A    = 0.06
      mu_r    = 0.06
      eps_A   = 0.067
      eps_r   = 0.067
      sigma_A = 0.33
      sigma_r = 0.5
    }
  }
